scope: Native macOS Settings and Activity windows; Ubuntu retains existing dialogs.
interactive_passes: Settings opens as a regular native window and is accessible to computer use
Native folder picker accepts a path containing spaces
Picker and setup-confirmation cancellation leave no service or selected configuration
New-folder setup creates private configuration and history, without starting synchronization
Existing mutual-TLS configuration imports without being rewritten or started
Previous folder configuration hash and history files preserved after import
Start and Stop operate the disposable LaunchAgent
Folder/configuration selectors disabled while synchronization is active
Disabling service login leaves the daemon running
Peers table shows actual loopback address and successful reconciliation times
Transfers table shows actual receiving path, payload bytes, target size, and start time
Graph and send/receive rates update during bidirectional transfers
Attention shows its empty state for a healthy snapshot
Stopped Activity explicitly labels historical data and hides live metrics
Rescan shows a native confirmation sheet
Command-1 opens Activity, Command-comma opens Settings, Command-W closes the current window
Activity opens safely before graph samples exist (JSON null history regression)
Command-Q quits the tray; same daemon PID continues and receives another file
automated_component_checks: empty, live, and historical native view states
snapshot updates do not trigger service/login actions
light and dark native component rendering
window closure does not dispatch stop

screenshots.desktop-macos.png: Genuine earlier af83390 single-icon menu capture, unconfigured; that header layout is unchanged by the native window work.
screenshots.desktop-macos-settings.png: Genuine installed native Settings window, unconfigured, after the startup fix.
screenshots.desktop-macos-activity.png: Genuine native Activity window during the verified two-peer transfer; no synthetic samples or compositing.

limitations: Interactive visual checks and screenshots use dark appearance; light appearance has automated AppKit rendering coverage.
Per-file upload names are absent from existing telemetry; the UI displays active upload counts.
No new Mac-to-Spark LAN, mDNS, login/logout, or clean-machine installation verification.
PR remains draft for review of the expanded native windows; no merge or release performed.
